scope: Three additive documentary files only. Preserve all existing tracked files and the full private audit-local tree. No participant-value parsing or inspection, contacts or inferred approvals.
negative_control_method: In-memory clones of the parsed acceptance JSON had each held authority flag flipped to true, then formal rights approval, institutional adoption, reviewer assignment or disposition invented one at a time. The held-state validator rejected all 21 mutations; no fixture files were created.
review_method: Same-agent source-to-snapshot review, JSON parsing, byte/SHA-256 verification, explicit content/status checks, in-memory negative controls and repository preservation checks. Not an independent human or institutional review, legal assessment or participant-data review.
snapshot_provenance: Full substantive immediately preceding chat account retained with historical pending-acceptance question and no-change statement explicitly framed as earlier-turn wording. No platform-authenticated export or message identifier available.

preservation.method: For each group: existing absolute file paths sorted case-sensitively; SHA-256 of UTF-8 concatenation of absolute_path TAB byte_length TAB uppercase_file_SHA256 LF. Extended Windows paths used for file access. Two complete scans returned identical count, byte total and digest.
preservation.scope_limit: Local tracked files and existing private audit-local files only. Opaque hashing did not parse participant values; no remote copies, cloud permissions, Git history contents, third-party copies or repository exposure inspected. Untracked acceptance files outside those groups are separately hashed; the audit does not self-hash.

proposed_commit.title: docs: record documentary acceptance of R09 reuse and access scope
description: Preserve the consolidated R09 account and record the author's exact documentary acceptance dated 25 October 2026.

Record intended non-commercial academic use, adaptation and redistribution with attribution and the same retained conditions for author-created code and supporting materials; treat third-party materials separately.
Use dependency references and installation instructions, with bundling subject to checked redistribution terms.
Keep participant-level data restricted, make no standing access offer and assess any future verification request separately without promising access.
Keep scientific decisions with the user; distinguish accepted preferences from a selected licence, authenticated ownership, institutional/coauthor approval or release authority.
Validate 31 content/status checks and 21 negative controls; confirm unchanged fingerprints for all 1,261 pre-existing tracked files and all 23,281 prior private audit files.
No participant inspection, contacts, fitting, analysis changes, licence application, cleanup, commit, push, synchronization or release.

completion_boundary: Completion means recording and auditing this documentary acceptance only. R09 formal response remains pending; licence selection/compatibility, rights, disclosure and release readiness remain unverified. R10 is not initiated.
